predictions.articleTitle: Guatemala vs Canada Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Depleted Canada Crack El Trebol? — Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Canada's attacking quality against a suspended Guatemalan midfield and their own seven-player injury attrition point toward a cautious, low-scoring first leg where the visitors either edge a narrow victory or settle for an away draw.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win captures both the narrow Canadian breakthrough led by Alphonso Davies and Jonathan David and the tight stalemate script ahead of Leg 2 in Toronto (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Total Goals aligns with a 2.25 combined lambda, three consecutive low-scoring head-to-heads, and Canada's 75.0% big-chance waste rate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
1:1 Draw Contingency accounts for Canada's depleted centre-back depth conceding once at El Trebol while struggling to convert chances cleanly (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Davies returns as injury-hit Canada test depleted Guatemala in Leg 1.

spf.comment: Covers both a narrow 0:1 Canada win driven by Davies and David against Guatemala's suspended core and a 1:1 draw caused by Canada's seven confirmed injuries; a single Away Win call is weaker given Canada's missing midfield spine.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.25 goal-based lambda total, three consecutive Under 2.5 head-to-heads, and four of Canada's last five matches staying at two goals or fewer.

score.comment: 0:1 reflects Canada's +225 Elo edge and three clean sheets in five games against a depleted Guatemala midfield, while 1:1 covers Canada's patched-up backline conceding at El Trebol amid high chance waste.

goals.comment: 2 goals (26.7%) and 1 goal (23.7%) represent the two highest-probability bands in the 2.25-lambda Poisson distribution and match Leg 1 knockout caution.

bqc.comment: Guatemala's compact home start and historical 0:0 half-times favour a level opening 45 minutes before Canada either break through late (Draw-Loss) or share the spoils (Draw-Draw).
